svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 997 x 497 mm with 25 mm flanges folded up on all four edges;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the side flanges stop 25 mm short of each corner (they clear the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front and back panel flanges). Fold the long flanges first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes, measured from the centre lines (x sideways, y front-back):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: eight 11 mm bolt holes matching the plinth top flange;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four 40 mm socket holes over the anchors, at 475 each side and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 220 each side of the centre, closed later with plastic caps;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one 25 mm gland hole for the grid cable at x 340, y 120.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: bolted to the plinth with eight M10 bolts, heads inside, nuts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the top flange (bolt it with the plinth on trestles).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The walls are riveted to the flanges with 4 mm blind rivets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flanges square, holes line up with the plinth.
